site.title: Joon Park
site.tagline: Illustration, prints and commissions from Bristol

posts.title: Snowy street, poster for Harbourside Market
posts.content: A winter poster for the Christmas market, printed as a two-colour screenprint in an edition of 60.

posts.title: Red mountain, book cover
posts.content: Cover for a travel memoir. The publisher wanted "a mountain that looks warm", so it is red.

posts.title: Heron at low tide
posts.content: For a feature on the Severn estuary. Drawn on location over two cold mornings.

posts.title: Medicinal plants chart
posts.content: Tea box wrap for a herbalist in Stokes Croft. 42 plants, each labelled by hand.

posts.title: Radiolarian, science festival poster
posts.content: Poster for the Bristol science festival. Printed in yellow and black on uncoated stock.

posts.title: Two ducks, spread for a picture book
posts.content: One spread from a picture book about a pond in winter. Gouache, painted at 120% of print size.

posts.title: Animal parade, mural study
posts.content: Study for a school hall mural. The final wall is 11 metres long and has a camel that the children named Steve.
